name: Duboka 1
subtitle: Kopaonik piste (curated way order)

provenance.method: The mapped red branch (727138468) descends from the Suvo Rudište top (1957 m DEM) but stops at z≈1654, short of the Duboka 1 base junction. Its end node (561950895) is the exact mapped merge node of the black branch (44225653); OSM documents that both branches merge near the lift base ('Obe staze se spajaju u jednu pri samom dnu'). The chain therefore continues along the shared lower corridor: 44225653 is spliced at the merge node and kept to its end at z≈1610, which matches the official finish (1975 − 373 = 1602 m within DEM resolution).
exclusionNotes: Way 44225633 is the vintage station-to-station mapping (base node 561951677 to top node 8568249171); only 16 coarse vertices, so it is redundant with the modern mapping and is excluded.
Way 915223221 duplicates the upper red corridor ~114 m east; including it would double-cover the same slope.
Way 727138472 covers a short upper stub; excluded for the same reason.
Connector ways 1161685058/1161685059/44225718 approach the base junction from other pistes (Krčmar, Kneževske bare) and are not part of Duboka 1 itself.
knownGaps: Official length (1440 m) vs prepared length: the official number references the race alignment station-to-station; the mapped red branch measures longer, mostly from extra mapped switchbacks.
Official vertical drop (373 m) counts from the 1975 m top-station platform; the mapped geometry starts ~20 m lower on the DEM (1957 m).
Race-line fidelity is unchecked against official course setting.

chainStrategy: curated ordered way list; red spine joined at the exact merge node to the black branch's shared lower corridor; oriented by DEM elevation
